title: query networks
description: Output of `hlp query networks --json`: one object per network, in the controller's order.

Purpose.description: The controller's purpose: corporate, wan, remote-user-vpn, ...

VLAN.description: The VLAN tag, 1 when VLANs are off, '' for WAN and VPN networks.

Gateway.description: The gateway's address on the network, or ''.

DHCP Range.description: First and last dynamic address, or ''.

Clients.description: Connected clients on the network; '' when the client list could not be read.
